title: Psychedelics and repeated spaceport/airport dreams?
content: Everytime I have used a specific psychedelic (😺) my lucid dreams are ALWAYS in the same sky high airport type space. I understand my mall LD's make sense, I'm a valley girl in California... I went to the mall a lot growing up. I'm very intrigued by my apartment on the beach LD's, I see a lot of you all have those ones! I haven't seen this covered much but I would very interested to know if others have these skyport LD's. The skyport dreams are also always 100% lucid for me. They have a different atmosphere consistency than regular LDs. I don't have AI photos for this place but I'll describe it in text detail. The skyport is very high in the sky or possibly in space, I don't see anything surrounding it. It is just sort of floating. It is built out of a concrete looking material and each building is connected to one another by bridges. Each building is a very tall structure, very castle like. I often see people I know as I am wandering and exploring. Anyone know what the heck I'm talking about? 😹
